mechanism: Meprobamate causes CNS depression and may potentiate empagliflozin-related orthostatic hypotension and dizziness through additive CNS effects and potential volume depletion from SGLT2 inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased dizziness, syncope, and orthostatic symptoms; counsel on fall risk and advise caution with position changes; consider alternative anxiolytic if CNS depression becomes problematic.
